name: PATCHGUARD — Autonomous CVE Monitoring & Remediation
description: Repository-scoped npm CVE monitoring with Dependabot, CISA KEV prioritization, conservative patch eligibility, deduplication, approval-gated Actions dispatch, and optional Telegram alerts. No AI or deployment.

main.node: Verify API Responses — Never Assume Zero
Normalize npm — KEV Priority and Eligibility
Record Dispatch Result — No Automatic Retry

nodes.name: Verify API Responses — Never Assume Zero
Normalize npm — KEV Priority and Eligibility
GitHub — Dispatch patchguard.yml
nodes.notes: Uses HTTP to inspect the 200/204 acceptance status and preserve ambiguous delivery without automatic retries. Do not select a credential or enable dispatch until approved.

nodes.name: Record Dispatch Result — No Automatic Retry

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item=>({json:{telegramDelivery:item.json.error?'failed':(item.json.ok===true || Number.isInteger(item.json.message_id) || Number.isInteger(item.json.result?.message_id))?'confirmed':'unconfirmed',response:item.json,notice:'Notification failure never means zero vulnerabilities. Inspect Prepare Telegram Alert for the original finding.'}}));

nodeGroups.name: 1 — Configuration
nodeGroups.description: Set the one repository and approval flags; invalid configuration blocks all API requests.

nodeGroups.name: 2 — Repository and CISA Intake
nodeNames: Verify API Responses — Never Assume Zero
nodeGroups.description: Read repo alerts and manifests, fresh CISA KEV, and Actions history; reject API errors and partial pages.

nodeGroups.name: 3 — Prioritize and Deduplicate
nodeNames: Normalize npm — KEV Priority and Eligibility
nodeGroups.description: Normalize npm fixes, match KEV, route manual review, suppress repeats, and require approval for one dispatch.

nodeGroups.name: 4 — Gated Patch Attempt
nodeNames: Record Dispatch Result — No Automatic Retry
nodeGroups.description: Dispatch patchguard.yml only after approvals; record accepted or uncertain delivery without retries.

nodeGroups.name: 5 — Telegram and Review Output
nodeGroups.description: Show manual review, previews, attempts and API failures; optionally send escaped Telegram alerts.
